notes.title: WE HAVE BEEN COOKING!🧑‍🍳
notes.content:
[h2][color="#00fc90"]Hi, 🧑‍💻 Delevoper is here![/color][/h2][p][/p]

We're excited to show you what we've been working on for the past month! Get ready for:

[list]
[*] A slick, localized UI 🔧

[*] A brand-new training map 🗺️

[*] Smoother shooting mechanics 🔫

[*] A complete endurance system overhaul 💪

[*] ...and a TON of bug squashing! 🐛
[/list]

[h2][color="#00fc90"]Playtest this month 10,000%[/color][/h2][p][/p]
